error.title: The status could not be loaded.
error.body: This is not an all-clear: whether anything is missing is unknown right now. Check the connection to the server and try again.

writeFailed: That could not be saved. Please try again.
empty: Nothing to do. Everything that applies to you is ready.

settingsRemoved.before: Some settings are gone: log size and count, the old country threshold and the OpenSky credentials.
settingsRemoved.after: They are removed, TravStats keeps running on fixed values.

backupsAlwaysOn.before: Automatic backups could be switched off.

retentionScheduledOnly.before: Retention also deleted backups made by hand.
retentionScheduledOnly.after: It now deletes only what the schedule created; everything else stays until you delete it.

friendsMerged.before: Friends and connections to other servers were separate.
friendsMerged.after: Each friend is now one connection on the Friends page.

servicesMovedOut.before: Services were configured through server environment variables.
servicesMovedOut.after: The values were copied into the settings on first start and are managed there.

ownServicesPublic.before: Your own Immich or Dawarich server could be reached on the home network.
ownServicesPublic.after: An ordinary account's connection must now point at a public address.

blockedHint: Only this server's admin can change this.

smtp.title: E-mail sending is not set up
smtp.consequence: Without a mail server TravStats cannot send invitations, password resets or reminders by e-mail.

publicUrl.title: Check the public address
publicUrl.consequence: Without a valid address that is reachable from outside, links in mails, pairing QR codes and sharing lead nowhere.

backup.title: Automatic backup
backup.consequence: Without a recent backup a disk failure loses everything stored on this server.

diskSpace.title: Disk space
diskSpace.consequence: When the disk is full, backups, uploads and the database itself fail.

offsiteCopy.title: Copy off site
offsiteCopy.consequence: A backup on the same machine does not survive losing that machine.

providerKeys.title: Data service keys
providerKeys.consequence: Without a valid key, flight search and live data return nothing, and nobody notices.

bookingMailbox.title: Booking mailbox
bookingMailbox.consequence: When the mailbox is unreachable, forwarded bookings never arrive.

domains.title: Choose your travel types
domains.consequence: Without chosen travel types TravStats shows only empty pages.

home.title: Set your home
home.consequence: Without a home TravTrack knows neither the way home nor departure places, and recognises stays less well.

phonePaired.title: Pair a phone
phonePaired.consequence: Without a paired phone the Companion app records and syncs nothing.

firstPosition.title: Receive the first position
firstPosition.consequence: The phone is paired, but no position has arrived yet.

ownApiKeys.title: Check your own keys
ownApiKeys.consequence: An expired key of your own makes lookups fail without a word.

forwardingAddress.title: Set up the forwarding address
forwardingAddress.consequence: Without forwarding and an allowed sender, no booking mail reaches you.

notificationEmail.title: E-mail for reminders
notificationEmail.consequence: Reminders by e-mail need an address to go to.
